items.title: Belém (PA) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 20 #7
items.en_title: Belém (PA) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 20 #7
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Belém (PA) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 796,600; proposals close Nov 20, 08:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
